title: Pretraining Pipelines & Scaling
description: Study corpus construction and provenance, deduplication and contamination, scaling laws and compute allocation, and packing, boundaries and checkpoint state. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Corpus construction and provenance
lessons.description: Define acceptance, exclusion, and provenance fields for three proposed text sources.
lessons.conceptOverview: A training corpus needs documented provenance, usage constraints, quality rules, and representation goals. Mixture weights determine which sources influence training. A large token count does not compensate for mislabeled, contaminated, or systematically biased data.
lessons.whyItMatters: Track source quality and mixture composition alongside total tokens.

lessons.title: Deduplication and contamination
lessons.description: Design exact and approximate duplicate checks, then test a paraphrased benchmark example.
lessons.conceptOverview: Deduplication reduces repeated examples and near-duplicate leakage. Contamination checks compare evaluation material with training sources using more than exact string equality. The detection method can miss paraphrases or shared templates, so document its limits.
lessons.whyItMatters: Use layered contamination checks and report what they cannot detect.

lessons.title: Scaling laws and compute allocation
lessons.description: Compare two hypothetical parameter/token allocations under the same training-compute budget.
lessons.conceptOverview: Scaling relationships describe empirical trends under particular training conditions. Under a fixed compute budget, model size and training-token count compete for resources. A compute-optimal training choice may differ from a deployment-optimal choice when inference volume is large.

lessons.title: Packing, boundaries and checkpoint state
lessons.description: Specify document boundaries, padding masks, and data-position state for a resumable pretraining run.
lessons.conceptOverview: Packing short documents can improve token utilization, but boundary and loss-mask rules determine what the model learns across documents. A restart must recover data position and configuration as well as model state to avoid accidental repetition or omission.
lessons.whyItMatters: Data-stream state is part of a reproducible pretraining checkpoint.
